components.css: .ds-glass{position:relative;display:flex;width:342px;height:56px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #fff;border-radius:20px;background:#56d9d2;color:#123c36;font:500 14px/22px 'Pretendard Variable',system-ui,sans-serif;transition:box-shadow 120ms ease-out;cursor:pointer}.ds-glass:active{box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,77,102,0.12)}.ds-glass:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #146b63;outline-offset:-4px}.ds-sweep{position:absolute;top:-29px;left:-161px;width:90px;height:130px;transform:rotate(18deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.65) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none}.ds-glass:active .ds-sweep{animation:ds-sweep 480ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards}@keyframes ds-sweep{to{transform:translateX(560px) rotate(18deg)}}

narrative.overview:
뽀득뽀득 records cleaning as color, not as a checklist. Tapping an item fills its card with the space's pastel; over the item's recommended cycle that fill thins in four soft stages but never disappears. Everything else stays quiet: a cool off-white page, white rounded surfaces, one mint-teal accent, and deep teal for anything that navigates. The atmosphere is ambient and non-punitive: nothing scores, warns, or scolds.

Density is a single calm column on a phone: 24px gutters, 12px between blocks, rows of 62-72px, generous touch targets. Depth comes from white-on-off-white tonal layering, not shadows. Motion is small and tactile: cards press to 0.97, the primary button throws one glass-like specular sweep per tap, and fades interpolate rather than step.

Sources of truth, in order: Figma page `02 · 전체 앱 — Light` (primary visual reference) and `01 · 디자인 시스템`, then this file, then shipped code. Figma also defines a full dark palette; it is deliberately not implemented. This system is light mode only until that decision changes.
keyCharacteristics: Color means "cared for recently"; its absence never means failure.
One accent (mint `sky-brand`) for primary action and selection; deep teal (`sky-deep`) for links, active nav, header titles, focus.
Four space pastels, each paired with a darker icon ink that never fades.
Flat tonal layering; shadow only on transient toasts.
Pretendard Variable throughout, Korean-first, zero letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Fade, Never Vanish Rule
rules.body: A recorded item's fill = space color at 100 / 72 / 48 / 28% as elapsed ÷ recommended cycle crosses 0 / 0.6 / 0.85 / ≥1.1, linearly interpolated between stops. It floors at 28%. A never-recorded item is white (0), not 28%. A space's fill is the average of its items' fades. Icons and text never fade. Implemented in `fadeForStaleness` / `itemFade` / `spaceFade` in `src/data/cleaning.ts`; do not reimplement.

rules.name: The Neutral Field Rule
rules.body: Page, header and surfaces stay neutral; pastels appear only on space tiles, recorded/selected cards and the home canvas.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: No raw hex in TSX or CSS; space colors come from `getSpace(key)` / `spaceColor(key, alpha)`. Exception: exported illustration fills and sweep gradients.

rules.name: The Weight Not Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing is 0 everywhere; emphasis is weight 700 or Deep Teal color.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, tiles and dialogs carry no drop shadow; separation is white-on-off-white plus radius.

dos: Do use `GlassButton` for every filled CTA (56 primary / 52 secondary), and the 44px Deep Teal text link for everything lighter.
Do derive every space fill from `getSpace` / `spaceColor` and every fade from `spaceFade` / `itemFade`, keeping icons and text at 100%.
Do keep 24px gutters, 12px block gaps, 44px minimum targets, and `pb-nav` on every screen with the bottom nav.
Do reuse `ItemRow`, `SpaceTile`, `SwitchRow`, `CheckRow`, `PageIntro`, `Pill`, `Dialog`, `Toast`/`useRouteToast` before writing a new row, card or modal.
Do take icons from the SVG registry and fade-stage wording from `FADE_STAGES`.
donts: Don't let a fill drop below 28% or render "stale" as a warning color; there is no red/amber state in this system.
Don't use the banned words or show a cleanliness score.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, rows, tiles or dialogs.
Don't use typographic glyphs (‹ › ⋯ ✓ ＋ ✦) or Material Symbols for UI icons.
Don't ship dark mode or the old MD3 blue palette; dark tokens live in Figma only for now.
